_meta.title: Odisea Adversarial QA / Red Team Defects Ledger v1.0

defects.title: Footnote tokens (fn:...) not expanded in export_html_snippet
defects.description: In heavy documents with 500+ footnotes, transform_inline did not match (fn:...) or (fn), emitting raw parenthesized text instead of <sup>[...]</sup> tags.
defects.fix_commit: Added inline scanner for (fn:...) and (fn) in transform_inline emitting <sup>[note]</sup>.

defects.title: Single quotes in font-family string literals rejected by ULSS lexer
defects.description: ULSS lexer only accepted double quotes '"', throwing 'Unexpected character in ULSS: '\'' when styles declared font-family: 'Segoe UI Variable'.
defects.fix_commit: Allowed both '"' and '\'' quote delimiters in UlssLexer tokenization.

defects.title: Variable definition with colon ($var: val) threw Expected '='
defects.description: ULSS parser strictly demanded '=' for variable assignments, breaking styles using CSS-flavored colon assignment syntax.
defects.fix_commit: Updated parse_variable_definition to accept both Token::Equals and Token::Colon.

defects.title: Mixin declaration with @mixin prefix threw Expected '{'
defects.description: ULSS parser expected @name { ... } directly and failed when authors declared @mixin name { ... }.
defects.fix_commit: Added lookahead check in parse_mixin_definition to extract identifier if token name is 'mixin'.

defects.title: Unresolved variable validThemeId in useOdiseaStore loadInitialData
defects.description: TypeScript compiler failed with TS2304 because validThemeId was referenced instead of resolvedThemeId.
defects.fix_commit: Replaced validThemeId with resolvedThemeId in useOdiseaStore.ts.

defects.title: Invalid icon property under app.windows[0]
defects.description: Tauri v2 rejected the 'icon' property under app.windows array.
defects.fix_commit: Removed obsolete window-level icon field; maintained bundle.icon array.

defects.title: Portable root resolution did not detect .cargo_target during unit tests
defects.description: When target dir was placed outside OneDrive, paths.rs treated deps folder as portable root, breaking snapshot tests.
defects.fix_commit: Updated get_portable_root() to detect any directory containing 'target' or 'deps'.

defects.title: Portable package relied on legacy Iniciar_Odisea.bat and server.cs
defects.description: Application required batch launchers and C# local HTTP server instead of a single direct native executable.
defects.fix_commit: Embedded frontend assets into native binary via Tauri generate_context, removed server scripts and batch files.

defects.title: Lack of session restoration and document/project history
defects.description: Application always started in global filter 'all' on first sheet, without remembering user's last session or history.
defects.fix_commit: Implemented session state persistence in config.toml, added HistoryItem ledger, and built HistoryModal with Ctrl+H.

session_and_history.theme_preservation: VERIFIED_PASS (dark/light and activeThemeId restored from config.toml)
